compliance_decision:
1. Inspectors are permitted to request documentation relating to STRs and access areas where such documents may be kept during an inspection for compliance purposes under Section 29 of the Financial Intelligence Centre Act (FICA).
2. Relevant Regulatory Basis: Sections 45B(2) & 785, PCC 42 - On S29 reports and Supervisory Bodies by Accountable and Reporting Institutions on February 2020.
3. Explanation: According to the regulatory context provided under Section 29 of FICA (as per Chunk 785, PCC 42), inspectors have specific powers during an inspection which include requesting and accessing documentation related to Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) as part of their compliance assessment.
4. Human Review Required: Yes
